other_conditions: Applicant must be an Ex‑Serviceman or the widow of an Ex‑Serviceman
Applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry
benefits_summary: Provides monthly financial assistance of ₹10,000 to WWII veterans and ₹9,000 to eligible non‑pensioner ex‑servicemen above 60 years (BPL) and their widows.
